brief: The full (logical) name of the service being called, including its package name, if applicable.
additional_context: Deprecated in OpenTelemetry for generic RPC spans. The value should be included in `rpc.method`, which is expected to be the fully-qualified name.
Still set on AWS SDK spans, where it holds the AWS service ID with all whitespace removed (e.g. `S3`, `APIGateway` for `API Gateway`) and `rpc.method` is set to the operation (e.g. `GetObject`).

changelog.description: Added additional context about the OpenTelemetry deprecation
